prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up portrait of two young women posed together in a lush, softly blurred outdoor setting with vibrant green foliage in the background. The woman on the left has long, dark hair and wears a cream-colored beret adorned with a red heart patch that says "LOVE." She leans her head gently on the shoulder of the woman on the right, creating an intimate and affectionate atmosphere. Both women have flawless, fair skin and wear subtle, natural makeup with a hint of pink blush and glossy lips. The woman on the right has straight, chestnut-brown hair and gazes directly at the camera with a gentle, serene expression, while the woman on the left looks slightly off to the side with a soft, contented smile. Their clothing is light-colored and simple, contributing to the fresh, innocent mood of the scene. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting their features and giving the image a dreamy, ethereal quality. The composition is tight, focusing on their faces and upper shoulders, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background, drawing attention to the subjects. The overall style is clean, vibrant, and reminiscent of a modern fashion or beauty editorial with a touch of whimsical romance.
